decisions.v3: Not activated: weaker ranking and acceptance than unchanged v2 on the same new v3 TEST and product cases.
decisions.calibration: Reranker and optional score calibration use source DEV only. DEV statistics are calibration measurements, not independent validation.
decisions.functional: Known regression failures informed generic input/index/ranking contract fixes. Repeat results are engineering checks and cannot be called a new independent holdout.

limitations: All 14 professions occur in training; only whole task families are held out.
Each positive scientific query has two relevant descriptions; fixed-denominator Precision@5 is at most 0.4.
Pair cutoff calibration on short task paragraphs differs from maximum over multiple sections of full profiles.
Top-50 retrieval and bounded token windows may miss relevant information.
CPU encoder timings exclude HTTP, model startup, index preparation and reranking.
Functional cohorts contain authored fictional profiles and expectations; results are not general hiring accuracy.
